gaps.lead: Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: The flat was too cramped for their three children.
gaps.sentence: The flat wasn't ___ their three children.
gaps.explanation: too cramped for = not spacious enough for.

gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.
